hero.headline: See every account, every movement, and where your money actually goes.
hero.subtitle: Savv brings your personal finances into one place: track balances, log income and expenses, organize with categories, and understand how your net worth evolves over time.

accounts.title: All your money in one place
accounts.subtitle: Manage multiple accounts and always know your overall financial position.

multiple.title: Multiple accounts
multiple.description: Cash, bank, savings — keep each balance updated without switching tools.

balance.title: Current balance
balance.description: Check what you have available right now, account by account.

netWorth.title: Net worth
netWorth.description: See the total of your accounts and how your wealth changes over time.

timeline.title: Balance over time
timeline.description: Follow the evolution of your money instead of guessing from memory.

movements.title: Log every movement
movements.subtitle: Movements are the source of truth. They build a real picture of your finances.

income.title: Income
income.description: Record salaries, freelance work, and any money coming in.

expense.title: Expenses
expense.description: Track daily spending and keep it organized with categories.

transfer.title: Transfers
transfer.description: Move money between accounts without treating it as income or expense.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Group movements so you can later understand where money goes.

movements.transferNote: A transfer between accounts is an internal money move — it does not count as real income or spending in your metrics.

analytics.title: Understand where you spend
analytics.subtitle: You don’t just record movements — you see what is happening with your money.

cashflow.title: Cashflow
cashflow.description: Compare money in versus money out for a clear monthly picture.

byCategory.title: Spend by category
byCategory.description: See which categories take most of your budget.

comparison.title: Income vs expenses
comparison.description: Spot whether you are ahead, balanced, or overspending.

evolution.title: Balance evolution
evolution.description: Watch how balances move across time, not just today.

averages.title: Category averages
averages.description: Understand your habits with average spend per category.

planning.title: Plan ahead with clarity
planning.subtitle: Know what you have today — and start anticipating how your finances will evolve.

upcoming.title: Upcoming payments
upcoming.description: See future movements before they affect today’s balance.

budgets.title: Category budgets
budgets.description: Set limits and track progress as you spend.

recurring.title: Recurring & fixed expenses
recurring.description: Rent, subscriptions, and other monthly commitments — without retyping them.

installments.title: Installments
installments.description: Break large purchases into scheduled payments you can follow.

projection.title: Balance projection
projection.description: Estimate how your balance may look after upcoming commitments.

planning.roadmapNote: These capabilities are part of the product direction and may roll out gradually.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: Four simple steps to get a clear view of your money.

1.title: Create your accounts
1.description: Add the accounts you actually use and set their starting balances.

2.title: Log income, expenses, and transfers
2.description: Capture every movement so balances stay accurate.

3.title: Organize with categories
3.description: Classify spending and income to unlock useful insights.

4.title: Analyze your situation
4.description: Review cashflow, net worth, and category trends with confidence.

finalCta.title: Start understanding your money better
finalCta.subtitle: Create a free account and bring your balances, movements, and spending habits into one clear view.
